headline: 146 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Little Giant Fire in WA, threatening 6,010 structures.

active_threats.name: Little Giant
active_threats.narrative: The Little Giant Fire in Chelan County, WA has burned 142,225 acres and is 15% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **6,010 structures threatened**. 2,338 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 17 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (N, blowing toward the S) favors pushing the fire toward Leavenworth city, 30 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over ID, MT: Coeur d'Alene city, Post Falls city, Kalispell city, Sandpoint city, and Polson city and 12 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 13% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
